fact: Webb Fontaine reported at the 15th Public Finance Review meeting in Cotonou that its AI-powered Webb Customs was adopted in 44 of Benin's 49 customs offices, having processed 59,000 declarations and enabled over 30 billion CFA francs in revenue, with the last five offices due mid-2025.
title: Webb Fontaine accelerates Benin's customs transformation with key milestones
